messages:
Asha (PM): Quick sync — shipping gate checklist for the upcoming feature roll. Need final decisions on SLAs, docs, support staffing, monitoring hooks, and pricing packs. Can everyone call out blockers by EOD?
Miguel (Eng): Working on runtime perf fixes. Main risk is p99 tail with long-context requests. I can drop a mitigation (KV caching) but needs a config change and a minor infra deploy. ETA tomorrow.
Sophie (SRE): For SLOs we suggested: 99.9% availability, p50 < 60ms, p95 < 150ms, p99 < 500ms for short requests. Long-context p99 will be higher. Do we lock these in or mark as provisional?
Asha (PM): Provisional allowed but must be documented in the launch notes. We should lock availability SLA for first week after ship. If SRE signs off on fallback behavior, we can ship.
Jon (Sales): Need clear language for pricing tiers — enterprise vs self-serve. Customers asked about committed throughput discounts and a burst policy. We should confirm default burst limits.
Miguel (Eng): For burst policy, default per-customer concurrency 20 with burst 40 for 2 minutes. Can change via Dedicated config. That should be in docs and API defaults.
Sophie (SRE): Monitoring hooks: require these metrics exported at launch: request_latency_{p50,p95,p99}, error_rate, queue_depth, kv_cache_hit_rate, model_fallback_count. Also add a log line for fallback events.
Asha (PM): Good. Who owns adding the fallback log? Miguel?
Miguel (Eng): Yep, I will add structured log: `{"event":"model_fallback","reason":"capacity|error","from_model":"m1","to_model":"m1-quant"}`. Will PR today.
Jon (Sales): Docs: need an FAQ explaining fallback behavior, pricing impact when fallbacks happen, and how customers can pin model versions. I'll draft copy.
Asha (PM): Support plan: first 72h we run elevated on-call. Sophie, can SRE take the first 48h and SEs cover business hours for conversion issues?
Sophie (SRE): We can do 48h SRE on-call. Need runbook entries: escalation steps, how to trigger failover to cold standby region, and paging thresholds.
Asha (PM): Runbook checklist — minimal content required in repo: incident play, rollback steps, contact list, and sample queries to check KV cache health.
Miguel (Eng): I added a short-runbook stub in the PR. Will expand with commands: ```
# check kv cache
curl -sS http://metrics/internal | jq '.kv_cache_hit_rate'
# trigger canary rollback
POST /admin/rollout/rollback {"deployment":"canary"}
```
Sophie (SRE): Nice. Also add alert thresholds: error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m, p99 latency > 1s for 10m, fallback_count spike > 10 in 1m.
Asha (PM): Pricing — Jon, propose a minimal starter plan for self-serve with fixed per-token price + per-embedding price and an enterprise committed-tier with 10% discount on > $X/mo. Also document how overages are billed.
Jon (Sales): Will do. Also propose an optional Dedicated plan note: reserved capacity pricing and how burst credits are consumed.
Asha (PM): Scope cut decisions: we will not include tiered model explainability in initial ship; keep it as an Optimize add-on. That reduces docs and UI scope. Everyone ok?
Miguel (Eng): Ok from eng side. Removes ~2 sprints of work.
Sophie (SRE): Good — fewer surface areas for incidents.
Jon (Sales): Fine. We should call out the missing piece in the launch doc so customers don't expect it.
Asha (PM): Final checklist for ship doc (quick bullets): 1) SLA statement (availability + tentative latency targets), 2) monitoring list + alert thresholds, 3) runbook with escalation, 4) API defaults + burst policy, 5) pricing doc + commit tiers, 6) docs FAQ on fallbacks and pinning, 7) support rota for 72h.
Miguel (Eng): I'll attach runtime config diff and the fallback log PR link when ready.
Sophie (SRE): I'll add the alert rules to prometheus repo and a Grafana dashboard panel.
Jon (Sales): I'll add pricing copy + a short blurb for customer-facing launch email.
Asha (PM): Great. If no further blockers, I'll mark the ship gate as 'ready-for-launch-review' by EOD and circulate the draft doc. @launch-bot can you create the checklist ticket? :rocket:
launch-bot: Created ticket #INC-4921 — "Shipping gate: criteria & owner confirmations" assigned to @Asha (PM), due 2026-05-12.
Asha (PM): Thanks. Closing comments — please post any late blockers in thread. :+1:
